strengths_deep_dive: Bayan Islamic Graduate School fills a specialized niche in North American higher education by offering accredited graduate degrees [4]. Its financial health is backed by <cite id="1">7.2 months of operating reserves</cite>, providing significant working capital stability [1]. The organization has also grown its financial footprint, generating <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $3,852,360 in FY2024</cite> with a <cite id="3">3-year revenue CAGR of 12.3%</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary: Bayan Islamic Graduate School offers specialized higher education to train leaders and scholars grounded in the Islamic tradition [4]. <cite id="3">Founded in 2011</cite>, the institution provides master's and doctoral degrees in Islamic chaplaincy, education, and leadership [4]. In FY2024, the organization reported a <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $3,852,360</cite>, demonstrating steady growth with a <cite id="3">3-year revenue CAGR of 12.3%</cite>. However, financial efficiency remains a notable limitation. In FY2024, the school maintained a <cite id="1">Program expense ratio of 52.0%</cite>, which falls significantly below the sector benchmark. On accountability, the institution holds an <cite id="1">overall score of 86.2/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> and maintains <cite id="1">7.2 months of operating reserves</cite> to support ongoing academic operations.
